title: Jobs
about: Names of jobs, like doctor, nurse, teacher and waiter, and the places where people work. How to ask and answer 'What do you do?' and 'Where do you work?'

items.pattern: a doctor · see a doctor · go to the doctor('s)
items.meaning: a person who helps ill people and tells them what medicine to take
items.example: I've got a bad cough, so I'm going to see the **doctor** today.
more: My aunt is a **doctor**. She often works at night.
The **doctor** looked at my sore throat and gave me some medicine.
items.watchOut: «Вона лікарка» — She's a doctor. Перед назвою професії в однині потрібен a/an: не She's doctor. «Піти до лікаря» — go to the doctor або go to the doctor's.

items.pattern: a teacher · a maths / English teacher
items.meaning: a person who helps students learn at school
items.example: Our new English **teacher** is very kind.
more: My mum is a **teacher** at a primary school.
Ask your **teacher** if you don't understand the homework.
items.watchOut: Звертання Teacher! англійською звучить незвично. У британській школі кажуть Mr Brown, Mrs або Ms Smith, а часто просто Miss або Sir.

items.pattern: a nurse · work as a nurse
items.meaning: a person who looks after ill people in hospital and helps the doctor
items.example: The **nurse** gave me a glass of water and checked my temperature.
more: My cousin wants to be a **nurse** when she leaves school.
A **nurse** put a plaster on my knee.
items.watchOut: Nurse — і жінка, і чоловік: He's a nurse (медбрат). Вимова /nɜːs/, без звука «у».

items.pattern: a mechanic · a car mechanic
items.meaning: a person who repairs cars and machines
items.example: Our car made a strange noise, so we took it to a **mechanic**.
more: The **mechanic** says the car will be ready on Friday.
My uncle is a **mechanic** and he loves old cars.
items.watchOut: Наголос на другому складі: me-CHA-nic, а ch тут звучить як «к».

items.pattern: a secretary · a school secretary
items.meaning: a person in an office who answers the phone, writes emails and plans meetings
items.example: Call the school **secretary** if your child is ill.
more: The **secretary** answered the phone and wrote down my name.
My mum works as a **secretary** in a big company.
items.watchOut: Наголос на першому складі: SEC-re-tary. Британці часто вимовляють лише три склади: /ˈsekrətri/.

items.pattern: a shop assistant · ask a shop assistant
items.meaning: a person who works in a shop, helps people and sells things
items.example: The **shop assistant** helped me find a jacket in my size.
more: I asked a **shop assistant** where the toys were.
There was only one **shop assistant**, so we waited a long time.
items.watchOut: «Продавець у магазині» — shop assistant (ще кажуть sales assistant). Seller зазвичай означає того, хто щось продає, наприклад онлайн, а не працівника магазину.

items.pattern: a hairdresser · go to the hairdresser('s)
items.meaning: a person who cuts and washes people's hair
items.example: The **hairdresser** cut my hair really short this time.
more: I'm going to the **hairdresser's** on Saturday morning.
My neighbour is a **hairdresser**, so she sometimes cuts my mum's hair.
items.watchOut: Перукарня — часто просто the hairdresser's (з 's): I'm going to the hairdresser's. Чоловічий перукар — ще barber.

items.pattern: an engineer · work as an engineer
items.meaning: a person who plans and builds roads, bridges, machines or buildings
items.example: My grandad was an **engineer**. He helped to build a big bridge.
more: She's studying maths because she wants to be an **engineer**.
The **engineers** are checking the new road.
items.watchOut: Перед engineer — an, бо слово починається з голосного звука: an engineer. Наголос у кінці: en-gi-NEER.

items.pattern: a farmer · work on a farm
items.meaning: a person who has a farm: grows food or keeps animals
items.example: The **farmer** has got two hundred cows and lots of sheep.
more: We buy fresh eggs from a **farmer** in the village.
In summer the **farmers** work from early morning.
items.watchOut: Фермер працює on a farm (на фермі), з on: не in a farm.

items.pattern: a police officer · the police
items.meaning: a person who works for the police and helps to keep people safe
items.example: A **police officer** helped the old man cross the busy road.
more: If you get lost, ask a **police officer**.
Two **police officers** were standing outside the football stadium.
items.watchOut: The police — уся поліція, і дієслово з ним у множині: The police are here. Про одну людину — a police officer, а не a police.

items.pattern: a traffic warden
items.meaning: a person in the town who checks where cars are parked and gives tickets to drivers who park in the wrong place
items.example: Dad parked outside the bakery, and a **traffic warden** gave him a ticket.
more: Be quick! There's a **traffic warden** near your car.
The **traffic warden** walks up and down our street every morning.
items.watchOut: Traffic warden не керує рухом — він стежить за паркуванням. Це британське слово. Вимова warden: /ˈwɔːdn/.

items.pattern: a librarian · work in a library
items.meaning: a person who works in a library and helps you find books
items.example: The **librarian** showed me where the books about animals were.
more: Our school **librarian** knows every book on the shelves.
Ask the **librarian** how long you can keep the book.
items.watchOut: Library — бібліотека, а не книгарня (книгарня — bookshop). Наголос: li-BRA-rian.

items.pattern: a bank clerk · work in a bank
items.meaning: a person who works in a bank and helps people with their money
items.example: My dad asked the **bank clerk** how to open an account for me.
more: The **bank clerk** counted the money twice.
My cousin got a job as a **bank clerk** after college.
items.watchOut: Британська вимова clerk — /klɑːk/, як «кларк», хоча пишеться з e. Американці кажуть /klɜːrk/.

items.pattern: What do you do? = What's your job? · What does he / she do? · I'm a / an + job
items.meaning: a question about someone's job
items.uk: Ким ти працюєш? / Яка в тебе робота?
items.example: '**What do you do**?' 'I'm a nurse.'
more: '**What does your dad do**?' 'He's a farmer.'
'**What's your job**?' 'I'm a hairdresser.'
items.watchOut: What do you do? питає про роботу. «Що ти зараз робиш?» — інше питання: What are you doing? Відповідь — I'm a / an + професія: I'm a teacher, не I'm teacher.

items.pattern: Where do you work? · Where does he / she work? · I work in a / an + place
items.meaning: a question about the place where someone has their job
items.example: '**Where do you work**?' 'In a big hotel in the centre of town.'
more: '**Where does your mum work**?' 'She works in a bank.'
'**Where do you work**?' 'I work in a café near the station.'
items.watchOut: У питанні потрібне do / does: Where do you work?, Where does she work? — не Where you work? і не Where she works?

items.pattern: a waiter · a waitress
items.meaning: a person who brings food and drinks to people in a restaurant or café
items.example: The **waiter** brought us two pizzas and some orange juice.
more: My brother works as a **waiter** in the summer holidays.
The **waitress** smiled and gave us the menu.
items.watchOut: Жінка — waitress, але сьогодні waiter часто кажуть про всіх. Щоб покликати офіціанта, зазвичай кажуть Excuse me!, а не Waiter!

items.pattern: a taxi driver · a bus driver · drive a taxi
items.meaning: a person whose job is to drive a taxi
items.example: The **taxi driver** took us from the airport to our hotel.
more: My uncle is a **taxi driver**, so he knows every street in the city.
Our **taxi driver** helped us with the heavy bags.
items.watchOut: Таксист — taxi driver: слова taxist англійською немає. Так само водій автобуса — bus driver.

items.pattern: a writer · write books / stories
items.meaning: a person who writes books or stories as their job
items.example: My favourite **writer** has a new book about a magic dog.
more: When I grow up, I want to be a **writer**.
A **writer** came to our school and read us a story.
items.watchOut: Буква w на початку не читається: /ˈraɪtə/, як у write.

items.pattern: a restaurant · work in a restaurant · go to a restaurant
items.meaning: a place where you pay to sit and eat a meal
items.example: We went to an Italian **restaurant** for my birthday.
more: The food in this **restaurant** is great.
My cousin works in a **restaurant** as a cook.
items.watchOut: Наголос на першому складі: RES-tau-rant. Середину британці вимовляють коротко: /ˈrestrɒnt/.

items.pattern: an office · work in an office
items.meaning: a room or building where people work at desks
items.example: My dad's **office** is on the tenth floor.
more: There's a coffee machine in our **office**.
Aunt Olga works in an **office** in the city centre.
items.watchOut: Перед office — an: an office. Працювати в офісі — work in an office, з in.

items.pattern: a factory · work in a factory
items.meaning: a big building where people and machines make things
items.example: This **factory** makes chocolate. It smells wonderful!
more: My grandma worked in a **factory** that made shoes.
There's a big car **factory** near our town.
items.watchOut: І фабрика, і завод — зазвичай factory. Fabric — хибний друг: це тканина, а не фабрика.

items.pattern: a shop · work in a shop · go to the shops
items.meaning: a place where you buy things
items.example: My sister works in a sports **shop** on Saturdays.
more: Is there a **shop** near here? I need some milk.
This **shop** sells toys and games.
items.watchOut: Британською — shop, американською — store. Магазин одягу — a clothes shop, не a shop of clothes.

items.pattern: a beauty salon · work in a beauty salon
items.meaning: a place where people go to have their hair, nails or face done
items.example: My aunt goes to the **beauty salon** near the station every month.
more: There's a new **beauty salon** on our street.
Lena works in a **beauty salon**. She does people's nails.
items.watchOut: Порядок слів: спершу beauty, потім salon — beauty salon, а не salon of beauty.

items.pattern: a hospital · work in / at a hospital · be in hospital
items.meaning: a big building where doctors and nurses look after ill people
items.example: My uncle broke his leg and spent three days in **hospital**.
more: The new **hospital** has a garden for the patients.
My mum works at the **hospital** at night.
items.watchOut: Про пацієнта британці кажуть in hospital, без артикля: He's in hospital. Наголос на першому складі: HOS-pi-tal.

items.pattern: work at home · work from home
items.meaning: do your job in your house, not in an office
items.example: On Fridays my mum **works from home**, so she can make us lunch.
more: Dad **works at home** and has a desk in the living room.
Lots of people **work from home** two days a week.
items.watchOut: Вдома — at home, з at: не in home. А «додому» — просто home, без to: go home.

items.pattern: an interesting job · a boring job · It's interesting / boring
items.meaning: a job you enjoy because it's different every day / a job that is not interesting
items.example: Being a vet is an **interesting job**. Every day is different.
more: Sometimes my job is **boring**. I do the same thing every day.
Do you think a farmer has an **interesting job**?
items.watchOut: Робота нудна — It's boring. Bored — про людину: I'm bored (мені нудно). Не a bored job. І ще: an interesting, але a boring.

warmup.explain: Перед професією в однині англійською потрібен a/an: She's a doctor. Перед doctor — a, бо слово починається з приголосного.
Про роботу питають What do you do? What are you doing? — «Що ти зараз робиш?». Без do питання не складається.
Завод, фабрика — factory. Fabric — хибний друг: це тканина. Farm — ферма.

warmup.uk: Я хочу працювати продавчинею в магазині.
warmup.explain: Продавець у магазині — shop assistant. Seller кажуть про того, хто щось продає взагалі, а shop seller не кажуть.
Таксист — taxi driver. Слова taxist англійською немає, а слово taxi стоїть перед driver.
Вдома — at home. Ще кажуть work from home — працювати з дому.
Нудний (про роботу, фільм) — boring. Bored — про людину: I'm bored, мені нудно. Boredom — нудьга.

warmup.q: Ask a ___ where the station is.
warmup.explain: Одна людина — a police officer. The police — це вся поліція.

A.q: Our car won't start. Let's call a ___.
Lena cuts and washes people's hair. She's a ___.
A.explain: Стриже й миє волосся hairdresser — перукарка.

A.q: Grandad has fields of potatoes and some chickens. He's a ___.
A.explain: Хто вирощує картоплю й тримає курей — farmer, фермер.

B.q: I want to borrow a book. I'll ask the ___.
B.explain: Книжки в бібліотеці видає librarian — бібліотекар.

B.q: Somebody took my bike! Let's tell a ___.
B.explain: Про крадіжку кажуть поліцейському — police officer.

B.q: Don't leave the car on the yellow lines. A ___ is coming!
B.explain: За паркуванням стежить traffic warden — інспектор з паркування.

C.explain: Про роботу питають What do you do? What do you work? англійською не кажуть.

C.q: The ___ brought us the menu and some water.
C.explain: У кафе меню приносить waiter — офіціант. Writer — письменник.

C.q: Dad writes emails and has meetings all day. He works in ___.
C.explain: Листи й зустрічі — це робота в офісі: in an office. На фермі — on a farm.

example.title: Mia's dream job
example.uk:
Минулого тижня до нашого класу прийшла нова дівчинка, Міа. Під час обіду я спитала її: «Ким працює твоя мама?»

«Вона медсестра у великій лікарні, — сказала Міа. — А мій тато таксист. А твої батьки?»

«Мій тато працює вдома. Він письменник, — сказала я. — Моя мама працює в офісі. Вона секретарка. Вона вважає, що її робота трохи нудна».

«Я мрію стати механіком, — сказала Міа. — Я обожнюю машини!»
example.en:
Last week a new girl, Mia, came to our class. At lunch I asked her, '[[What does your mum do|c1]]?'

'She's a [[nurse|a3]] at the big [[hospital|c11]],' said Mia. 'And my dad is a [[taxi driver|c4]]. What about your parents?'

'My dad [[works from home|c12]]. He's a [[writer|c5]],' I said. 'My mum works in an [[office|c7]]. She's a [[secretary|a5]]. She thinks her job is a bit [[boring|c13]].'

'My dream is to be a [[mechanic|a4]],' said Mia. 'I love cars!'
